title: Day 646 — Sheinbaum Rejects DEA Administrator's Claim That Mexican Government and Cartels Are 'One and the Same'
detail: On July 9, 2026 (Day 646, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum used her morning press conference to reject remarks made a day earlier by DEA Administrator Terry Cole, who asserted that the Mexican government and cartel networks were 'one and the same.' Sheinbaum characterized the comment as 'more like a political statement than one backed by evidence' and countered that the DEA would be better served focusing enforcement resources on drug trafficking and distribution networks inside the United States — the world's largest illicit drug market — rather than making unsubstantiated claims about the Mexican state. The exchange added to a summer of escalating rhetorical friction between Washington and Mexico City, coming amid separate U.S. accusations linking Mexican officials to cartel activity and just weeks before the anniversary of the April 2026 CIA-linked Chihuahua operation controversy. Sheinbaum's administration has consistently paired public rejection of such claims with data on its own security results, including double-digit percentage declines in national homicide rates since her October 2024 inauguration.

media.caption: President Sheinbaum responds to DEA Administrator Terry Cole's cartel-government claim at her morning press conference
